'''Kelberos Cannon '''is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''.

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:KelberosCannonNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Temple of Darkness -Hall of Demons-|Act 4-3,]] Kelberos Cannons are stationary turrets, designed after [[Kelbeross]]. They are palette swaps of [[Bazuka Soldier]]s, and do the same thing of shooting fireballs. Their contact only does 1 damage, but their fireball does 2 damage. Still, they are easily destroyed in one hit, and sub-weapons like the Windmill Star and Spin Slash will best penetrate through their projectiles.
